name: Malicious Intent

tenures.source: Named as a pairing during the WrestleKrazy II Arizona Street Fight, then wrestled together as a formal tag team the following week.

caption: A self-declared partnership of Alec Diablo and Big Jim Slade that beat the Innovators of Violence in tag competition after first fighting alongside Enigma at WrestleKrazy II.

name: Innovators of Violence

tenures.source: Wrestled Crusher as a four-man unit at WrestleKrazy II, and two of its members wrestled again as a tag team the following week.

caption: A four-man stable swept by Crusher in a handicap match at WrestleKrazy II, then beaten again in tag competition the following week.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (innovators-of-violence-ewa); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.
